correctness.rationale: The 2-core of two even cycles meeting at only their common vertex is precisely the union of intact cycles; dangling fragments iteratively peel away. With iid retention p the intersection probability is p^(a+b-1), yielding the full four-support probability generating polynomial, U=p^a+p^b-p^(a+b-1), and M=a p^a+b p^b-p^(a+b-1). The balancing-transfer nonempty difference factors as (1-p^2)(p^a-p^(b-2))>0 for b≥a+4. For the mean, H(t) has signs +,-,-,+, H(0)>0 and simple root H(1)=0 with H'(1)=2k>0; Descartes permits only one further positive root, which exists by continuity and lies in (0,1), proving unique crossing. The 11-vertex case B_(4,8) versus B_(6,6) has crossover p=1/sqrt(2). Independently enumerated all 2^n initial-retention configurations for (4,4),(4,6),(4,8),(6,6),(4,10),(6,8), matching the exact distributions and guild degrees; remaining arbitrary even parameters follow from algebra, not enumeration.
